name: mnemonic_recoil_mortar
label: Mnemonic Recoil Mortar
poeticVision: The desperate calculation: point, aim, surrender. Each 'shot' is a piece of Lyra's past, physically hurled into the void, a desperate gambit against the Silence. Players will feel the tangible weight of choosing which fragment of self to sacrifice, witnessing it shatter into weaponized truth, knowing that even if retrieved, it will echo with the scars of conflict.

parameters.name: muzzle_node
parameters.description: The Node3D representing the muzzle of the mortar, where shards are spawned and from where force is applied.

parameters.name: fire_force
parameters.description: The magnitude of the impulse applied to the memory shard when fired.

parameters.name: degradation_cost_per_shot
parameters.description: The amount by which the memory shard's integrity (and visual degradation) is reduced per shot (0.0 to 1.0).

parameters.name: shard_degradation_color
parameters.description: The color used to represent the degraded parts of the memory shard's material.

parameters.name: shard_degradation_noise_scale
parameters.description: Controls the scale of the noise pattern used for the degradation effect on the shard's material.

parameters.name: shard_degradation_edge_sharpness
parameters.description: Controls the sharpness of the degradation edges on the shard's material.

dependencies: MeshInstance3D (child of RigidBody3D in shard scene)
verdict: A weapon forged from the very essence of self, each desperate shot a fragment of Lyra's soul hurled into the void, echoing with the profound cost of survival.
impact: The player will constantly grapple with the emotional weight of their choices, turning every combat encounter into a desperate negotiation with their own identity. The visual and mechanical feedback of a memory degrading will create a visceral connection to Lyra's struggle, making survival feel both empowering and profoundly costly. This mechanic transforms a simple weapon into a central narrative device, deepening the themes of self-loss and the fight to retain who you are.
